structural_change: h16v gate (QW-COLLECT 23:45; CTS ODB TT placement RC, h16v_violators_by_rtl.txt): SRAM rd_out -> prog_q -321.5 (263 paths: macro clk->q 430 ps + ~560 ps wire to prog_q flops placed at their consumers); fixed_issue index -> next_row mux -> 32-b compare -> core_fault -282 (30 lv); gdesc_q -> g_present compare -> sel_g -> q -224; q_pw_addr -> row decode -> 376 row enables -151; q_pos -> dts quotient -> pq_r -158.  h16x RTL (H16X=1, exact, 0 edges; claude/qw-h16x-1020): program-store read issued one edge EARLY (controller fetch condition + prog_base+fpc) into a raw rd_out capture register p_cap (1024 kept flops, no logic), prog_q <= p_cap on the unchanged edge; next-row compare as a late select of two parallel KS compares; g_present registered with gdesc_q; calendar row write decode registered one edge early from pw_addr (u_isd input); dts quotient from pos one edge early (pq_p).  Same netlist chain/ABC as h16v (depth-oriented).  Same h16u/h16v geometry, single clock region.
